items.title: 52240_Frank _Machito_ Grillo oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Was it the composer Roger King Moizan? [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, the composer.

ctx.x: Okay, a few weeks later you recorded "Tanga" again for Verve, with Flip Phillips, and not long after that you recorded "Asia Minor". Now, how was "Asia Minor" - when was the first time someone presented "Asia Minor" to you, for a recording? Was it the composer Roger King Moizan?
